data.content_ref: inline:SRC_005 integrates the minimal-fixture constraint from SRC_001 with the typed-error-contract enforcement from SRC_002 by proposing a single frozen lease binding that asserts both a typed lease-mismatch code and endpoint drift detection before the provider call. The integration is refuted if the minimal fixture cannot simultaneously expose the drift field as a discrete mutable property and carry a typed exception contract without requiring a full provider manifest or additional routing topology context.
